name: acronym-bubble
description: Chrome extension: hover an acronym, see what it stands for.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/mova/bubble.jsx src/popup/popup.jsx src/pdf/viewer.js --outdir dist --splitting --format esm --production --entry-naming '[name].[ext]' --chunk-naming 'chunk-[hash].[ext]' && bun build src/background.js --outfile dist/background.js --format esm --target browser --production && tailwindcss -c src/mova/tailwind.config.cjs -i src/mova/mova.css -o dist/mova.css --minify && cp src/mova/LICENSE.mova dist/ && bun run pdfjs
scripts.pdfjs: P=node_modules/pdfjs-dist && cp $P/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs dist/pdf.worker.mjs && cp $P/web/pdf_viewer.css dist/ && cp -R $P/web/images dist/images && mkdir -p dist/pdfjs && cp -R $P/cmaps $P/standard_fonts dist/pdfjs/ && cp $P/LICENSE dist/LICENSE.pdfjs
scripts.check: bun run build && npm test && npm run e2e
scripts.check:zip: npm run zip && rm -rf .zip-check && mkdir .zip-check && unzip -q acronym-bubble.zip -d .zip-check && AB_ROOT=.zip-check node test/e2e/run.js; s=$?; rm -rf .zip-check; exit $s
scripts.zip: bun run build && rm -f acronym-bubble.zip && zip -qr acronym-bubble.zip manifest.json src/content.js src/content.css src/lib src/popup/popup.html src/pdf/viewer.html src/pdf/viewer.css dist icons -x '*.DS_Store'
